user.title: Matkahuolto package tracking
user.description: The coming and recently delivered packages of your matkahuolto.fi account. The access and refresh tokens are copied from your browser after logging in to matkahuolto.fi; the integration's README shows how.

data.stale_shipment_day_limit: Days until undelivered packages are hidden
data.completed_shipment_day_shown: Days until delivered packages are hidden

data_description.username: The email address of your matkahuolto.fi account. The sensor is named after it.
data_description.access_token: The access token from the login response, without quotation marks.
data_description.refresh_token: The refresh token from the same response. It renews the access token when that expires.
data_description.language: Language of the package event descriptions.
data_description.prioritize_undelivered: When there are more packages than the maximum, undelivered ones are listed before delivered ones.
data_description.max_shipments: How many packages the sensor lists.
data_description.stale_shipment_day_limit: Counted from the package's latest event. Some packages stay in delivery for good.
data_description.include_pickup_details: Add the pickup point and pickup code to package data. Off by default as this is sensitive data.

reauth_confirm.title: New tokens for {username}
reauth_confirm.description: Matkahuolto no longer accepts the tokens. Log in to matkahuolto.fi and copy new ones from your browser, as the integration's README shows.
